notes.processingOrder: Safety flags are applied to the FINAL herb list (Step 12), after all formula generation, modifier application, and secondary pattern integration. Safety always overrides formula logic.
notes.palpitationsDistinction: 'palpitations' in symptoms[] triggers the symptom modifier (Step 11). 'palpitations_flag' in safety_flags[] triggers the safety restriction (Step 12). These are independent and may both be active simultaneously.
notes.combinedFlags: If multiple safety flags are active, all blocked herb sets are merged. If both pregnancy and palpitations_flag are active, the combined blocked set is: mustard seed, clove, he shou wu, black pepper.
